title: a task's stack is freed while on-stack envs still point into it, and the GC then marks freed memory
live_proof: upstream fixed it in cb51fce92 (cb51fce921fc7beceb5337231c0e17b7299c1279) (2026-07-31), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: SIGABRT (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: SIGABRT); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
status: sysalloc-none, sysalloc-bounds and sublet-gc measured 2026-10-06 on the Capstone application VM; cheribsd-revocation not run
